title.en: Brick Size: Double Cylinder Plunger Mortar Spraying Machine keeps Output is 4 m³/h
title.zh: 砖的尺寸：双缸柱塞订单是 9/11 kW 和 4 m³/h保留「输送量是 4 m³/h。」

description.en: Double Cylinder Plunger Mortar Spraying Machine at /products/double-cylinder-plunger-mortar-spraying-machine. Output is 4 m³/h Motors are 9/11 kW
description.zh: 双缸柱塞订单是 9/11 kW 和 4 m³/h见 /products/double-cylinder-plunger-mortar-spraying-machine。输送量是 4 m³/h。电机是 9/11 kW。

h1.en: Mortar Required for Common Bricks is the heading; Double Cylinder Plunger Mortar Spraying Machine stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「需要的砂浆 用于 普通砖」，主体仍是双缸柱塞订单是 9/11 kW 和 4 m³/h

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Double Cylinder Plunger Mortar Spraying Machine. The row to open is /products/double-cylinder-plunger-mortar-spraying-machine. Output is 4 m³/h. Motors are 9/11 kW. This page prints 9/11 kW. Type 511 is 7.5 kW and 3 m³/h. No trailer page here is named by 4 m³/h. German-type and the 5 m³/h hydraulic page print 7.5/9 kW. Send the 9/11 kW path to /en/contact/ if 380 V can feed those motors. Write “sprayer” in the inquiry so it cannot be read as a 4 m³/h trailer. It is not the German-type 3–5 m³/h page and not Electric 10 Series at 21 m³/h. It is not a trailer pump’s H / V cell copied from Electric 20, which is also 120 m / 40 m on a different machine. The selection note places it at 4 m³/h and 8 MPa, with particle context separate from Type 511’s ≤6 mm / 3 m³/h window. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints this spraying machine at 380 V, motors 9/11 kW, all-copper dual motor, 4 m³/h, 8 MPa, 100 m / 40 m and hose 38/51 mm. The section title “Brick Size” comes from the source page and does not add a rating.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是双缸柱塞订单是 9/11 kW 和 4 m³/h的数字。要打开的行是 /products/double-cylinder-plunger-mortar-spraying-machine。输送量是 4 m³/h。电机是 9/11 kW。这一页印 9/11 kW。511 是 7.5 kW、3 m³/h。这里没有以 4 m³/h 命名的拖泵页。它不是从电动20抄来的拖泵 H / V。电动20是另一台机器上的 120 m / 40 m。德式机和 5 m³/h 液压页印 7.5/9 kW。询盘里写“喷涂机”，这样才不会被读成 4 m³/h 的拖泵。它不是德式 3–5 m³/h 那一页，也不是 21 m³/h 的电动10系列。如果 380 V 能供给这些电机，把 9/11 kW 的路径发到 /zh/contact/。选型说明把它放在 4 m³/h 和 8 MPa，粒径窗口与 511 的 ≤6 mm / 3 m³/h 分开。河北品锦机械（邢台）把这台喷涂机印成 380 V、电机 9/11 kW、全铜双电机、4 m³/h、8 MPa、100 m / 40 m、软管 38/51 mm。节标题「砖的尺寸」来自来源页，不另加额定值。

body.en: This section is titled “Brick Size”. Double Cylinder Plunger Mortar Spraying Machine still prints the cells below. Output is 4 m³/h. No trailer page here is named by 4 m³/h. It is not the German-type 3–5 m³/h page and not Electric 10 Series at 21 m³/h.
body.zh: 本节标题是「砖的尺寸」。双缸柱塞订单是 9/11 kW 和 4 m³/h下面这些格子仍是印出来的。输送量是 4 m³/h。这里没有以 4 m³/h 命名的拖泵页。它不是德式 3–5 m³/h 那一页，也不是 21 m³/h 的电动10系列。它不是从电动20抄来的拖泵 H / V。

heading.zh: 需要的砂浆 用于 普通砖

body.en: Under “Mortar Required for Common Bricks”, Double Cylinder Plunger Mortar Spraying Machine contributes only the printed cells in this part. Motors are 9/11 kW. German-type and the 5 m³/h hydraulic page print 7.5/9 kW. It is not a trailer pump’s H / V cell copied from Electric 20, which is also 120 m / 40 m on a different machine.
body.zh: 在「需要的砂浆 用于 普通砖」下，双缸柱塞订单是 9/11 kW 和 4 m³/h这一节只放已印出的格子。电机是 9/11 kW。德式机和 5 m³/h 液压页印 7.5/9 kW。电动20是另一台机器上的 120 m / 40 m。

heading.zh: 砖墙 - 选用的 砌合方式

body.en: “Brick Walls - Selected Bond Patterns” titles this part of the Double Cylinder Plunger Mortar Spraying Machine note. The figures stay the printed ones. This page prints 9/11 kW. Send the 9/11 kW path to /en/contact/ if 380 V can feed those motors. The selection note places it at 4 m³/h and 8 MPa, with particle context separate from Type 511’s ≤6 mm / 3 m³/h window.
body.zh: 「砖墙 - 选用的 砌合方式」是双缸柱塞订单是 9/11 kW 和 4 m³/h这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。这一页印 9/11 kW。如果 380 V 能供给这些电机，把 9/11 kW 的路径发到 /zh/contact/。选型说明把它放在 4 m³/h 和 8 MPa，粒径窗口与 511 的 ≤6 mm / 3 m³/h 分开。

body.en: For Double Cylinder Plunger Mortar Spraying Machine, the heading “Brick Orientation” does not replace a cell. Type 511 is 7.5 kW and 3 m³/h. Write “sprayer” in the inquiry so it cannot be read as a 4 m³/h trailer. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints this spraying machine at 380 V, motors 9/11 kW, all-copper dual motor, 4 m³/h, 8 MPa, 100 m / 40 m and hose 38/51 mm. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/brick-mortar-consumption-d_1549.html.
body.zh: 对双缸柱塞订单是 9/11 kW 和 4 m³/h而言，标题「砖的摆向」并不替换任何格子。511 是 7.5 kW、3 m³/h。询盘里写“喷涂机”，这样才不会被读成 4 m³/h 的拖泵。河北品锦机械（邢台）把这台喷涂机印成 380 V、电机 9/11 kW、全铜双电机、4 m³/h、8 MPa、100 m / 40 m、软管 38/51 mm。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/brick-mortar-consumption-d_1549.html。

answer.zh: 不会。输送量是 4 m³/h。仍是双缸柱塞订单是 9/11 kW 和 4 m³/h已印的说法。
